## #2 — frank beckmann — 2013-01-12
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/9217/post-76172>

confirming ..

[[QUOTE:  Transini said: Nothing happens... nothing? Click to expand... ]]

All of your stuff in the object-browser is now selected instead by cmd+A.  
It´s now an "explicit" feature - means you have to select a component first to tell which kind (points/edges/polygons) you want to "select all". 
The context menu entry is not working - you´re right. Martin is informed. But cmd+A still works.
